explanations.text: Residues 1-12 of chain A (12 residues): mean pLDDT 64.3. Fraction of residues by bin: very high local model confidence 25%; relatively high local model confidence 25%; low local model confidence 25%; very low local model confidence 25%. Predicted aligned error (PAE) for residues 1-12 of chain A: mean 4.4 A, maximum 9.8 A across 144 residue pairs. PAE is the model's estimate of the expected position error of one residue when the structure is aligned on another, so it is a relative uncertainty between residue pairs. Lower values mean lower predicted relative uncertainty. Model confidence is not evidence of folding, binding, affinity, efficacy, safety, or experimental validation.
